stories.summary: Show the token usage, cost and turn count recorded when a run finished on its report, with zero, absent and invalid telemetry shown as not recorded or zero and no credential values stored or shown

Open a run's trace from its report and see it marked with the installation's test-environment identity, with tracing disabled and an unavailable trace store shown on the report without failing the run

See on the run report whether a run's transcript, logs and results are retained, expired under the three-month default or a configured period, or pending deletion, while audit-critical run metadata and shared bundles remain
Purge a run's transcripts, logs and results on project-owner request and see the purged state on the report, with authorization, idempotence, a reported failure and a retryable failure
